methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
To fill these gaps in the literature, we propose a practical solution for
evaluating and prioritizing EEPs.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper presents an MCDM framework for prioritizing energy-efficiency projects, not an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
Therefore, we applied the same
FAHP approach to two petrochemical firms (one from Ireland and the
other from Qatar) and compared the results to those of the current case
study (Egyptian petrochemical complex).

stage1.notes: Ineligible under the explicit tool/framework rule: MCDM scores rank EEP alternatives but do not measure or normalise energy performance.
